---

ConnConfig contains all the options used to establish a connection. It must be created by [ParseConfig](file:///home/utilitydelta/sandbox/v42-corpus/pgx/conn.go#238,6) and then it can be modified. A manually initialized ConnConfig will cause [ConnectConfig](file:///home/utilitydelta/sandbox/v42-corpus/pgx/conn.go#155,6) to panic.
